pages.title: A Biome by Recipe
pages.text: The cauldron lets you deliberately change an allowed biome area.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Craft the sack from Sweet Tooth and drag food onto it; it feeds a hungry carrier. Eat a Biome Treat while fully starving in the desired biome, toss it into the crucible and fulfill all requests including its final rare item.
